scope.included: Scythe 2016 base/core multiplayer for 2–5 players; full exact candidate material claims and important omissions.
scope.method: Read full new candidate against complete authoritative source already read in this continuing independent source-only review. Re-read original PDF p. 11 for regrouped occupation and worker-entry rules. Source production, mat/recruit, six-tile and scoring diagrams have been visually inspected in this review. No benchmarks, keys, readers, grading, coverage or prior reports accessed; no repairs authored or existing files edited.

checked_claims.claims_and_assessment: Enemy-workers-only paragraph correctly prohibits independent worker entry while those workers control the territory. Separate enemy-character/mech paragraph correctly prohibits independent entry and exit. Enemy-structure-only entry stays legal. Plastic entry still stops, immediate undefended-worker retreat is not combat, and protected plastic combats remain after all movement. No legality or timing changed by regrouping.

Correct faction counts, combat-capable plastic units, players+1 Factory cards with unseen remainder, eleven encounter tokens, random tile/mats, seating, correct starting tracks/cards/coins and two objectives, all piece destinations/empty one-time spaces, lowest mat starts.
Public hand count with concealment of combat-card commitment until reveal, secret contents and objectives, coins not hidden but total need not be disclosed.

Clockwise individual turns/no rounds; distinct section except Rusviet incl Factory, optional top then bottom once each even Rusviet, either/both/neither; full exposed red cost before optional green benefit, top may fund bottom, dead turns and appropriate bottom-choice overlap.

Bases never territories, normal entry/build/deploy restrictions with setup/retreat/Wayfare exceptions, inactive placeholders; unit or own structure with no enemy unit controls, enemy worker controls occupied structure/resources, defender temporarily controls pending battle, owner keeps abilities except uncontrolled Mill. Only four resources not workers, any controlled resources pay remote costs to supply, otherwise stay on board; unlimited supply/stacking.

Two distinct sequential units one step or one coin pre-upgrade; all carry resources, only mechs workers not characters, carried workers retain own move; river/lake defaults and shoreline interpretation, printed tunnels adjacent and own Mine even enemy-controlled with ordinary entry restrictions; Speed extra plastic step and mid-move loading, tunnel step one.

Any unit may enter enemy-structure-only control. Workers cannot independently enter enemy-worker control, or move independently into/out of enemy plastic control. Character/mech entering enemy units stops for turn. Undefended workers immediately retreat home leaving resources with one popularity each down to zero, not combat. Finish movement then attacker-ordered combats then encounter before subsequent bottom. Character encounters stop for turn; lost contested encounter leaves token.

One coin for two power or card pre-upgrade with correct reshuffle/exhaustion; one coin for any two resources or popularity, resource destination controlled worker territory and no resource Trade if all workers home; correct Monument/Armory additions.

Current full cost before production, up to two distinct controlled territories pre-upgrade, per-worker terrain output at producing territory; correct five products, no lake/Factory output. Left-to-right optional permanent new workers after payment, exposed costs future only. Controlled Mill adds territory and worker-equivalent output alongside actual workers, can produce alone; two+Mill up to three, upgraded three+Mill up to four.

Correct oil/metal/wood/food mapping and exposed mat quantity, varying costs/coins, optional coins, completed paid actions continue coins/recruits, announce action. Upgrade improves top/reduces bottom but pay before cube movement, any green to empty bracketed red not solid-border red.

Normal placement controlled worker territory, no lake/home base, ability all plastic not workers; one structure total per territory incl opponents, Factory allowed, permanence/no enemy ability use. Armory power Trade, Monument popularity Bolster, Mill controlled, Mine personal tunnel all unit movement incl Factory even enemy controlled.

Any recruit to any empty permanent one-time slot for two power/coins/popularity/cards; ongoing original section one power Upgrade, coin Deploy, popularity Build, card Enlist. Self/immediate neighbors matching bottom, active-left-right, two-player opponent once, no top/Factory/encounter trigger, sixth-star cutoff.

Rusviet repeats incl Factory; Crimea once per turn one card as one resource irrespective value; Nordic workers river-cross not lake; Polania two different options from one encounter any order and first may fund second; Saxony retains second objective and no usual combat/objective cap within available stars.
Rusviet farms/villages, Crimea farms/tundra, Nordic and Saxony forests/mountains, Polania villages/mountains; unlocked character/mech scope excludes workers, all factions unlock Speed.

Character-only after full move/all combats, lost contested battle leaves token; show card/art and thematic capitals aloud, required affordable option except Polania, full cost optional gains, all resources/units/buildings at encounter territory, no normal costs/mat/recruit extras, face-down deck bottom.

Pooled complete resource pairs/floor, not workers/cards; own structure bonus survives enemy control but no ordinary territory/resource rights. Tie order workers+mechs+structures, power, popularity, resources, territories, stars.

Adjacent printed tunnels 1/2–3/4–5/6 pay 2/4/6/9; lakes/encounters 1/2–3/4–5/6–7 same; on tunnels 1/2/3–4 pay 2/4/6; longest straight row and combined farms/tundra 1/2/3/4 pay 2/4/6/9. important_omission_review: No important in-scope omission found. Exact mat-dependent quantities appropriately refer to exposed physical mat boxes; exhaustive component inventory, combat-card frequencies, narrative/strategy and optional teaching notes are acceptable summary omissions.
limitations: Source-only supplied-base-rulebook scope; no external FAQ, later edition or component-card corpus audited.
conclusion: PASS for candidate-repair-09 exact hash. Regrouped worker restrictions match source p. 11 and retain movement, control, retreat and combat timing. Full candidate has no identified material contradiction or important core multiplayer omission.
